title: FTS5 + sutra_lessons query tool
description:
## Parent

sutra/150 — Code-anchored lessons: sutra_remember / contextual surfacing

## What to build

Add an FTS5 virtual table on `lessons.text` and a new `sutra_lessons` MCP tool for explicit lesson queries. This is the direct-lookup complement to contextual surfacing — for when an agent wants to proactively check "what do we know about sqlite" before writing new code.

Query interface: `sutra_lessons(query?, category?, symbol?, verified?)`. Supports FTS5 text search, structured filtering by category tag, symbol anchor, and verification status. Results include full lesson data (text, anchors, categories, confidence, provenance).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] FTS5 virtual table created on `lessons.text` (in lessons.db migration)
- [ ] `sutra_lessons` MCP tool registered and callable
- [ ] Text search via FTS5 returns relevant lessons ranked by relevance
- [ ] Structured filters (category, symbol, verified) narrow results correctly
- [ ] Combined text + structured filters work together
- [ ] Empty/no-match queries return empty results, not errors
- [ ] Tests: FTS5 ranking, filter combinations, empty results

## Blocked by

- sutra/152 — 5x-review-1
